description:
Route a run on foot from a start point through ordered stops, by default back to the start.
Stops are climbs from find_climbs (way_id, run bottom to top; repeats runs extra reps back down and up) or lat/lon points.
Returns distance, ascent and descent, gain and loss for each km, an elevation profile every 100 m,
a GPX download link (gpxUrl) and a map link (mapUrl), and a vertfinderUrl for each climb on the route. Route links expire at expiresAt.
To hit a target such as 750 m ascent over 30 km: find big climbs with find_climbs sort_by: gain,
order stops so the climbing falls where the target profile needs it, add repeats for extra gain,
then compare gainPerKm with the target and adjust stops.
Each account can plan only a few routes a day, so settle the stops before calling, and keep them within about 100 km.

lat.description: start latitude; with lon, takes precedence over location

location.description: start: postcode, town or place name, searched worldwide: add a region or country (e.g. "Richmond, North Yorkshire, UK") and check the returned location. Required unless lat and lon are given.

lon.description: start longitude; with lat, takes precedence over location

return_to_start.description: finish back at the start (default true)

lat.description: latitude of a point to pass through (with lon, instead of way_id)

lon.description: longitude of a point to pass through (with lat, instead of way_id)

repeats.description: times to run the climb, 1-10 (default 1); extra reps go back to the bottom and up again

way_id.description: a wayId from find_climbs; routed bottom to top

name: plan_route
